Marlasniroha ma disi sudena naung tinobus;
Masihol situtu do i di Jesus i partobus.
Ro do muse Tuhanta i. d.u.
Satongkin nari nangkok be marhitehite ombun;

Ma-si-hol si-tu-tu do i di Je-sus i par-to-bus.

Sai lo-ngang be do sa-su-de
di ha-sa-nga-pon i mu-se.
Di sur-go, di na so-nang. Di sur-go, di na so-nang.

rows: Ma-lu-ngun do ro-hang-ki-non di a-ri-Mi, o Tu-han!
An-di-gan jum-pang ha-ro-roM ma-no-pot ha-su-du-ngan
Ni ro-ha-mi, ai a-la nii so-nang do ro-ha-na-mi, Ha-taM hu-i-ngot ha-mi.

verses: Malungun do rohangkinon di ariMi, o Tuhan!
Andigan jumpang haroroM manopot hasudungan
Ni rohami, ai ala nii sonang do rohanami,
HataM huingot hami.
Sai hupaima hami Ho, Ho do pangulunami.
Ai nunga pola mate Ho pasaehon dosanami;
Dibahen i pos rohangki, sai urupanMu hami
Di pardalanannami.
Sai huhaposi hami Ho di sitaononnami
Naung saor tu tondinami do tondiM, o Tuhannami.
Asi rohaM, ale Tuhan, parade rohanami
Di haroroM tu hami.
Masihol rohanami be di hasonangan sogot.
Na so mansohot be tahe, tusi ma au pabongot!
NajinouMi tu lambungMi, sai tong do las rohana
Tiur huhut langkana.
Sai ro ma Ho tu hami on, ungkap do rohanami.
Naeng ingananMu i tongtong, pasaut pangeleknami.
Di haroroM tu hami on, marolopolop hami,
Ho pasangaponnami.
title: Tongtong tutu na denggan do
status: Lirik dicek · 19/20 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Sai hu-pa-i-ma ha-mi Ho, Ho do pa-ngu-lu-na-mi.
Ai nu-nga po-la ma-te Ho pa-sae-hon do-sa-na-mi;
Di-ba-hen i pos ro-hang-ki, sai u-ru-pan-Mu ha-mi Di par-da-la-nan-na-mi.
Sai hu-ha-po-si ha-mi Ho di si-ta-o-non-na-mi
Naung saor tu ton-di-na-mi do ton-diM, o Tu-han-na-mi.
A-si ro-haM, a-le Tu-han, pa-ra-de ro-ha-na-mi Di ha-ro-roM tu ha-mi.
Ma-si-hol ro-ha-na-mi be di ha-so-na-ngan so-got.
Na so man-so-hot be ta-he, tu-si ma au pa-bo-ngot!
Na-ji-nou-Mi tu lam-bung-Mi, sai tong do las ro-ha-na Ti-ur hu-hut lang-ka-na.
Sai ro ma Ho tu ha-mi on, ung-kap do ro-ha-na-mi.
Naeng i-nga-nan-Mu i tong-tong, pa-saut pa-nge-lek-na-mi.
Di ha-ro-roM tu ha-mi on, mar-o-lop-o-lop ha-mi, Ho pa-sa-nga-pon-na-mi.

checks: Pembanding lirik: beda: ayat 2 baris 2 (pembanding tanpa satu kata), "do" (ayat 4 baris 4), "i" (ayat 5 baris 2), "paurak" (ayat 10); ayat 2 baris 2 dicek ulang ke scan: tercetak "Asa ihuthononku, ale Tuhan, togu au". Ejaan buku dipertahankan.

rows: Na ma-lu-ngun do ro-hang-ku tu Ho, o De-ba-tang-ki
Ho do na hi-na-po-san-ku ja-la ha-po-ru-san-ki
Sa-su-de na ro tu Ho, ndang ta-ru-rak ba-he-non-mu; Na-sa na ma-noi-si Ho, i do na pa-i-la-on-Mu.

verses: Na malungun do rohangku tu Ho, o Debatangki
Ho do na hinaposanku jala haporusanki
Sasude na ro tu Ho, ndang tarurak bahenonmu;
Nasa na manoisi Ho, i do na pailaonMu.
Pabotohon ma dalanMu dohot bogasMi di au,
Asa ihuthononku, ale Tuhan, togu au
Sian dalan na ture dohot tu hasintonganMu;
Ho do hatuaonki, tolongMi do paimaonku.
Ingot ma, ale Tuhanku, angka denggan ni basaM,
Naung di au pinasahatMu, dohot asi ni rohaM!
Unang ingot dosangki na hubahen di posongku,
Sai asi ma rohaMi, ala lambas ni rohaMu.
Ndang marolat denggan basa ni Jahowa na bonar;
Diajarhon tu pardosa dalan angka na tigor.
Na serep marroha i ditogihon tu na sonang,
Na lambok marroha i do diboan tu na torang.
Hasintongan, asi roha, do dalanna sasude
Di sude na burju roha mangoloi patikNa i.
Tuhan, ala goarMi, sesa ma sude dosangku,
Ai mansai godang do i, lobi asa bilanganku.
Ise do mangkabiari Debata Jahowa i?
Halak i do diajari, lao tu hangoluan i.
Sonang do tondiNa i dibagasan hasonangan,
Jala pinomparNa i do tumean hasiangan.
Hasudungan ni Jahowa do na bonar roha i,
Hahomion ni Tuhanna jadi do botoon ni.
Sai tongtong do matangki mangaranap tu Tuhanku;
Dipalua do pathi sian jorgong ni musungku.
Au na punjung jala dangol, tatap ma, o Tuhanki;
Ai tu Ho do au masihol, sai palua tondingki.
Tu gandana do tongtong hagogotan ni rohangku,
Sai palua ma au on, ale Tuhan Debatangku!
Tatap ma pardangolanku dohot hangalutanki;
Sesa ma sude dosangku, sai papir ma tondingki.
Lam torop do musungki, lam jorbut do pamuraina;
Tuhan, tatap au disi, asa unang saut tahina.
Sai ramoti ma tondingku, Tuhan, sai palua au;
Ho, haposan ni rohangku, unang ma paurak au.
Sai jamot ma tondingki ala ni halidangonku.
Bangso na pinillitMi naeng tangkas paluaonMu.
title: Na malungun do rohangku
status: Lirik dicek · 36/40 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Pa-bo-to-hon ma da-lan-Mu do-hot bo-gas-Mi di au,
A-sa i-hut-ho-non-ku, a-le Tu-han, to-gu a-u
Sian da-lan na tu-re do-hot tu ha-sin-to-ngan-Mu; Ho do ha-tu-a-on-ki, to-long-Mi do pa-i-ma-on-ku.
I-ngot ma, a-le Tu-han-ku, ang-ka deng-gan ni ba-saM,
Naung di au pi-na-sa-hat-Mu, do-hot a-si ni ro-haM!
U-nang i-ngot do-sang-ki na hu-ba-hen di po-song-ku, Sai a-si ma ro-ha-Mi, a-la lam-bas ni ro-ha-Mu.
Ndang ma-ro-lat deng-gan ba-sa ni Ja-ho-wa na bo-nar;
Di-a-jar-hon tu par-do-sa da-lan ang-ka na ti-gor.
Na se-rep mar-ro-ha i di-to-gi-hon tu na so-nang, Na lam-bok mar-ro-ha i do di-bo-an tu na to-rang.
Ha-sin-to-ngan, a-si ro-ha, do da-lan-na sa-su-de
Di su-de na bur-ju ro-ha ma-ngo-loi pa-tik-Na i.
Tu-han, a-la go-ar-Mi, se-sa ma su-de do-sang-ku, Ai man-sai go-dang do i, lo-bi a-sa bi-la-ngan-ku.
I-se do mang-ka-bi-a-ri De-ba-ta Ja-ho-wa i?
Ha-lak i do di-a-ja-ri, lao tu ha-ngo-lu-an i.
So-nang do ton-di-Na i di-ba-ga-san ha-so-na-ngan, Ja-la pi-nom-par-Na i do tu-me-an ha-si-a-ngan.
Ha-su-du-ngan ni Ja-ho-wa do na bo-nar ro-ha i,
Ha-ho-mi-on ni Tu-han-na ja-di do bo-to-on ni.
Sai tong-tong do ma-tang-ki ma-nga-ra-nap tu Tu-han-ku; Di-pa-lu-a do pat-hi si-an jor-gong ni mu-sung-ku.
Au na pun-jung ja-la da-ngol, ta-tap ma, o Tu-han-ki;
Ai tu Ho do au ma-si-hol, sai pa-lu-a ton-ding-ki.
Tu gan-da-na do tong-tong ha-go-go-tan ni ro-hang-ku, Sai pa-lu-a ma au on, a-le Tu-han De-ba-tang-ku!
Ta-tap ma par-da-ngo-lan-ku do-hot ha-nga-lu-tan-ki;
Se-sa ma su-de do-sang-ku, sai pa-pir ma ton-ding-ki.
Lam to-rop do mu-sung-ki, lam jor-but do pa-mu-rai-na; Tu-han, ta-tap au di-si, a-sa u-nang saut ta-hi-na.
Sai ra-mo-ti ma ton-ding-ku, Tu-han, sai pa-lu-a au;
Ho, ha-po-san ni ro-hang-ku, u-nang ma pa-u-rak au.
Sai ja-mot ma ton-ding-ki a-la ni ha-li-da-ngon-ku. Bang-so na pi-nil-lit-Mi naeng tang-kas pa-lu-a-on-Mu.

checks: Pembanding lirik: beda: ayat 5 baris 4 "Denggan" (ejaan). Ejaan buku dipertahankan.

rows: So-ngon ur-sa na bi-nu-ru mau-as di aek ta-bar i,
So-ngon i do au ma-ngi-do, naeng sol-hot tu Tu-han-ki
Ho-lan Ho, De-ba-tang-ki do hu-ha-u-as-hon i. Ai an-di-gan i-da-on-ku bo-hi-Mi, a-le Tu-han-ku.

verses: Songon ursa na binuru mauas di aek tabar i,
Songon i do au mangido, naeng solhot tu Tuhanki
Holan Ho, Debatangki do huhauashon i.
Ai andigan idaonku bohiMi, ale Tuhanku.
Iluilu ni matangku do hupangan sai tongtong,
Ala sai didok musungku: tung di dia Debatam?
Jala maras rohangki mingot parmasuhonki,
Ro di girgir ni endengku, lao tu joro ni Tuhanku.
TungkiMi, ale tondingku! Tung beasa rusak ho?
Sai haposi Debatamu, ai paluaonNa do ho,
Na marsak i nuaeng, las roham muse dibaen,
Asa tong pasangaponmu goar ni partuaonmu.
Sai manungkap do rohangku di na mangandungi au;
Jordan do habuanganku dohot Hermon na sai dao,
Songon aek sampuran i tinggang tu tondolan ni,
Songon i do martinggangan tu au angka pangunjunan.
Diparbaga Debatangku asi ni rohaNa i
Di au, jadi las rohangku, molo sai huingot i.
Borngin nang arian pe huendehon do sude
Denggan basa ni Jahowa, na manolong naposoNa.
O partanobatoanku, ndang be ingotonmu au?
Ai lam ganda do arsakku, diinsahi musu au.
Ai holiholingku pe naung magopu do sude,
Ala sai didok musungku: tung di dia Debatamu?
Tungkimi, ale tondingku! Tung beasa rusak ho?
Sai haposi ma Tuhanmu, ndang tadingkononNa ho.
Pujionku do muse Tuhan Debata dope,
Hatuaon ni bohingku na tongtong naeng haposanku.
title: Ai beasa di balian?
status: Lirik dicek · 27/28 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: I-lu-i-lu ni ma-tang-ku do hu-pa-ngan sai tong-tong,
A-la sai di-dok mu-sung-ku: tung di di-a De-ba-tam?
Ja-la ma-ras ro-hang-ki mi-ngot par-ma-su-hon-ki, Ro di gir-gir ni en-deng-ku, lao tu jo-ro ni Tu-han-ku.
Tung-ki-Mi, a-le ton-ding-ku! Tung be-a-sa ru-sak ho?
Sai ha-po-si De-ba-ta-mu, ai pa-lu-a-on-Na do
ho, Na mar-sak i nu-aeng, las ro-ham mu-se di-baen, A-sa tong pa-sa-nga-pon-mu go-ar ni par-tu-a-on-mu.
Sai ma-nung-kap do ro-hang-ku di na ma-ngan-du-ngi au;
Jor-dan do ha-bu-a-ngan-ku do-hot Her-mon na sai dao,
So-ngon aek sam-pu-ran i ting-gang tu ton-do-lan ni, So-ngon i do mar-ting-ga-ngan tu au ang-ka pa-ngun-ju-nan.
Di-par-ba-ga De-ba-tang-ku a-si ni ro-ha-Na i
Di au, ja-di las ro-hang-ku, mo-lo sai hu-i-ngot i.
Bor-ngin nang a-ri-an pe hu-en-de-hon do su-de Deng-gan ba-sa ni Ja-ho-wa, na ma-no-long na-po-so-Na.
O par-ta-no-ba-to-an-ku, ndang be i-ngo-ton-mu au?
Ai lam gan-da do ar-sak-ku, di-in-sa-hi mu-su au.
Ai ho-li-ho-ling-ku pe naung ma-go-pu do su-de, A-la sai di-dok mu-sung-ku: tung di di-a De-ba-ta-mu?
Tung-ki-mi, a-le ton-ding-ku! Tung be-a-sa ru-sak ho?
Sai ha-po-si ma Tu-han-mu, ndang ta-ding-ko-non-Na ho.
Pu-ji-on-ku do mu-se Tu-han De-ba-ta do-pe, Ha-tu-a-on ni bo-hing-ku na tong-tong naeng ha-po-san-ku.

checks: Pembanding lirik: beda ejaan: "manida" (ayat 2), "namarningot" (ayat 4), "marasi", "denggan" (ayat 6). Ejaan buku dipertahankan.

rows: Ha-mu sa-lu-hut ha-ra-ja-on, mar-o-lop-o-lop ma ha-mu! En-de-hon ma ha-mu-li-a-on ni go-ar ni De-ba-ta-mu! Tu De-ba-ta ma dok ha-mu-na na song-kal do pam-bae-nan-Mi; Ai mu-su-mi pe sa-lu-hut-na mar-som-ba do di jo-lo-Mi.

verses: Hamu saluhut harajaon, marolopolop ma hamu!
Endehon ma hamuliaon ni goar ni Debatamu!
Tu Debata ma dok hamuna na songkal do pambaenanMi;
Ai musumi pe saluhutna marsomba do di joloMi.
Tu Ho, o Tuhan do marsomba muse sandok portibi on;
GoarMu do endehononna, pasangaponna Ho tongtong.
Ro ma hamu saluhut jolma, manida pambahenan ni
Jahowa, na sai marmulia di nasa manisia i.
Endehon ma Debatanami saluhut bangso, puji be
Na pangoluhon tondinaMi, huhut na pasonangkon pe.
O Tuhan, nunga dipapita Ho hami doshon perak i,
Lao pabalihon nasa tihas, patauhon tu na denggan i.
JoroM do na naeng masuhanku, mambaen di Ho pelean i;
Marlasniroha gararonku sude, naung huparbaga i.
Ai namarningot do rohangku di angka bagabagangki,
Na puas sian pamanganku, andorang na targogot i.
Hamuna, na mangkabiari Jahowa, ro ma sasude,
Ro ma hamu mananginangi binaenNa i di au sude!
Joujou do au tu Debatangku di na tarsosak au dope,
Lam tu tangkasna di rohangku na tau mambaen sangapNa pe.
Girgir hupuji Debatangku, na sai marasi roha i;
Ndang ditulakkon tangiangku, dibege do soarangki.
Na dangol do au jala pogos, huhut tarhilang sai tongtong.
Alai Tuhanku do manongos, denggan basaNa di au on.
title: Hamu saluhut harajaon
status: Lirik dicek · 20/24 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Tu Ho, o Tu-han do mar-som-ba mu-se san-dok por-ti-bi on; Go-ar-Mu do en-de-ho-non-na, pa-sa-nga-pon-na Ho tong-tong. Ro ma ha-mu sa-lu-hut jol-ma, ma-ni-da pam-ba-he-nan ni Ja-ho-wa, na sai mar-mu-li-a di na-sa ma-ni-si-a i.

En-de-hon ma De-ba-ta-na-mi sa-lu-hut bang-so, pu-ji be Na pa-ngo-lu-hon ton-di-na-Mi, hu-hut na pa-so-nang-kon pe. O Tu-han, nu-nga di-pa-pi-ta Ho ha-mi do-shon pe-rak i, Lao pa-ba-li-hon na-sa ti-has, pa-tau-hon tu na deng-gan i.

Jo-roM do na naeng ma-su-han-ku, mam-baen di Ho pe-le-an i; Mar-las-ni-ro-ha ga-ra-ron-ku su-de, naung hu-par-ba-ga i. Ai na-mar-ni-ngot do ro-hang-ku di ang-ka ba-ga-ba-gang-ki, Na pu-as si-an pa-ma-ngan-ku, an-do-rang na tar-go-got i.

Ha-mu-na, na mang-ka-bia-ri Ja-ho-wa, ro ma sa-su-de, Ro ma ha-mu ma-na-ngi-na-ngi bi-naen-Na i di au su-de! Jou-jo-u do au tu De-ba-tang-ku di na tar-so-sak au do-pe, Lam tu tang-kas-na di ro-hang-ku na tau mam-baen sa-ngap-Na pe.

Gir-gir hu-pu-ji De-ba-tang-ku, na sai mar-a-si ro-ha i; Ndang di-tu-lak-kon ta-ngi-ang-ku, di-be-ge do so-a-rang-ki. Na da-ngol do au ja-la po-gos, hu-hut tar-hi-lang sai tong-tong. A-lai Tu-han-ku do ma-no-ngos, deng-gan ba-sa-Na di au on.

checks: Pembanding lirik: beda: "Malalasongan" (ayat 1), ayat 1 baris 5 (kata ke-2 "mago" tidak ada di pembanding), ayat 3 baris 4 (pembanding tanpa satu kata), "Di baen" (ayat 4). Ejaan buku dipertahankan.
Bagian Ende Psalm, judul bagian "Psalm 68". Kredit dicetak "Matthaus Greitter" (ejaan lazim: Matthäus Greiter); ditulis sesuai buku.
Ayat 1 disusun dari lirik di bawah not (pemenggalan baris mengikuti ayat 2).

rows: Sai he-he ma Tu-han-ta i, mam-baen ho-hom mu-su-Na i, ma-po-rus di jo-lo-Na.
So-bok-kon ti-mus lao su-de, ma-la-la-so-ngan pan-tis pe, ni-om-bus ni ho-sa-Na.
Ai na mang-a-lo Tu-han i, i ma su-de par-ja-hat i, Lao ma-go do lu-hut-na; Pa-me-reng ni Ja-ho-wa i, Na ma-no-ru-si sa-su-de, i do pa-se-rak-hon-sa.

verses: Sai hehe ma Tuhanta i, mambaen hohom musuNa i,
Maporus di joloNa. Sobokkon timus lao sude,
Malalasongan pantis pe, niombus ni hosaNa.
Ai na mangalo Tuhan i, i ma sude parjahat i,
Lao mago do luhutna; Pamereng ni Jahowa i,
Na manorusi sasude, i do paserakhonsa.
Alai marlasniroha ma partigor i di Debata,
Huhut marhasonangan, marolopolop ma sude,
Girgir mamujimuji be, marroha hatorangan.
Endehon Debatanta i, sai puji ma goarNa i
Pasangap ma Ibana, patigor ma dalanNa i,
Na sian halongonan i; Tuhanta do ibana.
Manungkap be ma hita on mamuji Debata tongtong,
Dibaen denggan basaNa, taporsan pe na dokdok i,
Tuhanta, siampehon i do mangurupi hita,
Nda pujionta goarNi nampuna hatuaon i,
Jahowa Debatanta? Ai ro pe hagogotan i,
Nang songgop hamatean pe, sai dipalua hita.
O Israel, Debatami do mangalehon gogomi,
Di baen asi rohaNa, o Debata, di bangsoMi
Pahot na pinatupaMi, tambai hagogoonNa,
Ai sian i tandaon ni na manggomgomi bangso i,
O Debata, sangapMu, dung i sai ro ma sasude,
Mamboan tu joroM muse, Jahowa, peleanmu.
Songkal do Debatanta i, ro sian ingananNa i
Na marhabadiaon, Ibana do Debata ni
BangsoNa, hinophopNa i, silehon hagogoon.
Tutu, holong rohaNa i di nasa na porsea i,
Ditatap do bangsoNa, antong sai tapasangap ma
Na sasadasa Debata; Tapuji ma goarNa.
title: Sai hehe ma Tuhanta i
status: Lirik dicek · 26/30 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: A-lai mar-las-ni-ro-ha ma par-ti-gor i di De-ba-ta, Hu-hut mar-ha-so-na-ngan,
mar-o-lop-o-lop ma su-de, Gir-gir ma-mu-ji-mu-ji be, mar-ro-ha ha-to-ra-ngan.
En-de-hon De-ba-tan-ta i, sai pu-ji ma go-ar-Na i Pa-sa-ngap ma I-ba-na, pa-ti-gor ma da-lan-Na i, Na si-an ha-lo-ngo-nan i; Tu-han-ta do i-ba-na.
Ma-nung-kap be ma hi-ta on ma-mu-ji De-ba-ta tong-tong, Di-baen deng-gan ba-sa-Na,
ta-por-san pe na dok-dok i, Tu-han-ta, si-am-pe-hon i do ma-ngu-ru-pi hi-ta,
Nda pu-ji-on-ta go-ar-Ni nam-pu-na ha-tu-a-on i, Ja-ho-wa De-ba-tan-ta? Ai ro pe ha-go-go-tan i, Nang song-gop ha-ma-te-an pe, sai di-pa-lu-a hi-ta.
O Is-ra-el, De-ba-ta-mi do ma-nga-le-hon go-go-mi, Di baen a-si ro-ha-Na,
o De-ba-ta, di bang-so-Mi Pa-hot na pi-na-tu-pa-Mi, tam-bai ha-go-go-on-Na,
Ai si-an i tan-da-on ni na mang-gom-go-mi bang-so i, O De-ba-ta, sa-ngap-Mu, dung i sai ro ma sa-su-de, Mam-bo-an tu jo-roM mu-se, Ja-ho-wa, pe-le-an-mu.
Song-kal do De-ba-tan-ta i, ro si-an i-nga-nan-Na i Na mar-ha-ba-di-a-on,
I-ba-na do De-ba-ta ni Bang-so-Na, hi-nop-hop-Na i, si-le-hon ha-go-go-on.
Tu-tu, ho-long ro-ha-Na i di na-sa na por-se-a i, Di-ta-tap do bang-so-Na, an-tong sai ta-pa-sa-ngap ma Na sa-sa-da-sa De-ba-ta; Ta-pu-ji ma go-ar-Na.

verses: Tongtong longang do rohangkon di hinadenggan ni joroM,
Jahowa Sebaot, Tuhanku. Mansai malungun rohangki,
Naeng lao tu alamanna i, Solhot tu habadiaonMu.
Ho, Sipangolu tondingki, naeng pujionku do disi.
Amporik, leangleang i, marasar do di jabumi.
Marpangondian tu langgatan, au on pe, ale Rajangki,
PasabamonMu ma disi, tu Ho do au marhasahatan;
Martua halak sasude, na mangingani joroMi.
Tutu, martua halak i, na mangasahon gogoMi,
Huhut mardalan di dalanMu, nang pe mamolus jolma i
Di rura partangisan i, parmualanna do basaMu.
Mabaor do pasupasuMi tongtong gogo tu jolma i.
Lam leleng pardalanan ni, lam ganda do gogoNa i,
Ai sahat do sude tu Sion, paeleng, Tuhan, pinggolMi,
Tangihon ma tangiangki, sai tongos ma pangurupion,
Manogu au tu joloMi, mamujimuji goarMi.
Ho lombulombu situtu di nasa jolma na burju,
Sai tatap na miniahanMu, sadari pe di jabuMi
Dumenggan sian ari i, saribu di parholanganMu;
Lea pe au di tano on, asal maringan di joroM.
Panondang, lombulombu pe do Debata di hita be.
Na marhaposan tu Ibana, ai asi ni rohaNa i,
Nang pe hamuliaon i, dilehon tu hasudunganNa.
O Tuhan, sai martua do na marhaposan i tu Ho.

r: Am-po-rik, le-ang-le-ang i, ma-ra-sar do di ja-bu-mi. Mar-pa-ngon-di-an tu lang-ga-tan, au on pe, a-le Ra-jang-ki, Pa-sa-ba-mon-Mu ma di-si,
tu Ho do au mar-ha-sa-ha-tan; Mar-tu-a ha-lak sa-su-de, na ma-ngi-nga-ni jo-ro-Mi.
Tu-tu, mar-tu-a ha-lak i, na ma-nga-sa-hon go-go-Mi, Hu-hut mar-da-lan di da-lan-Mu, nang pe ma-mo-lus jol-ma i Di ru-ra par-ta-ngi-san i,
par-mu-a-lan-na do ba-sa-Mu. Ma-baor do pa-su-pa-su-Mi tong-tong go-go tu jol-ma i.
Lam le-leng par-da-la-nan ni, lam gan-da do go-go-Na i, Ai sa-hat do su-de tu Si-on, pa-e-leng, Tu-han, ping-gol-Mi, Ta-ngi-hon ma ta-ngi-ang-ki,
sai to-ngos ma pa-ngu-ru-pi-on, Ma-no-gu au tu jo-lo-Mi, ma-mu-ji-mu-ji go-ar-Mi.
Ho lom-bu-lom-bu si-tu-tu di na-sa jol-ma na bur-ju, Sai ta-tap na mi-ni-a-han-Mu, sa-da-ri pe di ja-bu-Mi Du-meng-gan si-an a-ri i,
sa-ri-bu di par-ho-la-ngan-Mu; Le-a pe au di ta-no on, a-sal ma-ri-ngan di jo-roM.
Pa-non-dang, lom-bu-lom-bu pe do De-ba-ta di hi-ta be. Na mar-ha-po-san tu I-ba-na, ai a-si ni ro-ha-Na i, Nang pe ha-mu-li-a-on i,
di-le-hon tu ha-su-du-ngan-Na. O Tu-han, sai mar-tu-a do na mar-ha-po-san i tu Ho.
